name: Coursera
description: Bring your organization's trusted Coursera catalog into the flow of your Claude conversations. The Coursera connector enables seamless integration between Claude and your learning content, allowing you to instantly discover courses, short videos, hands-on projects, learning paths, and certificates. Going beyond simple search, the connector makes active learning a native part of your day by dynamically generating real-world practice scenarios, like professional role plays, grounded in verified learning material. Bridge theory to practice in a safe environment and receive structured feedback to accelerate skill mastery, all without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coursera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coursera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.coursera.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coursera MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coursera provides these MCP tools: coursera_roleplay_practice, search_courses, search_videos, search_hands_on_learning, and get_course_material.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coursera?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coursera in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Coursera requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coursera is developed by Coursera. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
